title: No, I’m not looking for a job @StackOverflow
description: NO! I AM NOT DOING THIS FOR MONEY! #causeascene

asr.full_text: I'm I wanted to take a moment um... because something has been on my mind and I'm holding the camera so... on my phone... so excuse me if it gets a little wobbly. But something has been on my mind and those who know me by now know I have to process, by making these videos, things become clearer for me An there's something I really want to address as um... I continue to push the envelope or cause a scene, which is the strategic disruption of the status quo in our technical organizations, communities and events with Stack Overflow, I really want to address that because it's been said a few times that I'm doing this because I want them to hire me as a consultant or I'm looking for a job. I'm branding myself. All these things. All these things could be true, but they're really not. The Branded-a-Thing, was the reason that I started doing these videos. But this hashtag cause of scene has become so much bigger than anything I decided to be transparent here. Um, I have, I live my life or attempt to live my life as closely as possible to a spiritual principle that says that there is abundance. There is no lack or limitation in my life. Freely, I give and freely I receive from the storehouse. So that's my philosophy. And that is, as I process I'm really seeing how that's connected and why I'm so, I can't get away from inclusion. And why it's in everything I see now. Yes the privilege thing is shocking every time we see the Starbucks event that happened this weekend. I can't tell you how many times I went to us gone to a Starbucks connected to their internet and they're they're their Wi-Fi and plugged in to charge my devices and never bought anything I'd do it all the time. So the privilege thing is an issue. and that was one of the reasons that I had to take a break few weeks ago because I saw myself getting caught up in what's wrong, putting out what's wrong and what's wrong in a way in ways that I had no control over having no impact on it. I really didn't have a voice I really didn't have a strategy for it. And so it becomes frustrating and scary for me and for people like me because who wants to live in a world where you can get arrested just for sitting in a Starbucks waiting on a friend. That's just crazy. But that's not, as I said, the privilege part, though jolting though i said when we see people of color see it we're like slapped in the face again because it exists that's not where i do this i do this work and it's just becoming more clear to me and more clear to me and more clear to me because and again many of you won't understand this is my spiritual work this is what I was put here in this space to do Now I don't know what it happen tomorrow but today I'm in the tech space with the skills that I have with the empathy that I have with the ability to communicate that I do to improve inclusion and diversity in the Tech, our tech community AND, again when I talk about, again, I want to define terms here Diversity, is about variety So think about having a Crayola box of crayons and there's, no matter if you have the four-count, the 8-count, the 16, 64, whatever There's variety, there's usually more than 1 crayon in there And when we, kids or whatever, use the crayons They have the same number for the same time of year. Usually people would like a crayon that's from something, like 2016, 64 or whatever. There's variety. There's usually more than one crayon, there. And when we when kids or whatever, using crayons, we get so excited when they pick out the different colors and they're playing with the different colors and they're creating things with a gift of coverless because that brings out the beauty in something. So that's what diversity is for me. but inclusion is my holy grail. It is the thing where everybody, people of privilege, people who are underrepresented, people who are marginalized, anybody in there who I have not counted or included, feels comfortable, has an experience of being welcomed and treated well and feel that their safety, mental, physical, and spiritual, emotional safety, is, physical, and spiritual and emotional safety is not gonna be trad upon, being in that space. So, no I'm not doing this for money. I'm not. And I know that there are people in my network particularly the legal white men who are concerned about me thinking and believing that I'm giving away content that Stack Overflow can use without hiring me as a consultant. I'm sure that's true, it's happened before, and that's why many of them are concerned. There are many groups in this community who have tapped me or other people with this kind of background with this kind of expertise used us for that and did not pay us or did not pay you're well for the for the impact for the return on investment they go but you know what I don't even care I can't live my life if I believe in abundance if I believe that everything I do will come back to me I cannot live like that if I'm holding back information because I fear that Stack Overflow or anybody else is gonna steal my content I don't do this for them I don't do this for me I do this because I have to there is a community of people out there who and I'm talking about people who are in this non-technical space. We do this for them We need to remember that this is not for us technical people who on the spectrum People who know, who think they know everything, from the people who are just learning and are getting into this space This is for your mom your nephew your daughter your your neighbor all of these individuals who are trusting us and we can see this in this in the Facebook example we can see this in the uber example there are trusting to create products and services that solve their daily problems. That's why I do that. So, anybody who is questioning my motives this is, this video is for YOU. This is the last time I am going to address this. And if you say something in my feed that is directed to that, I will simply drop this video in so that you can understand this is not why I do this. I do this because this is my spiritual mission. This is something I cannot step away from and it goes beyond Stack Overflow. But they are the biggest player in this game of people who are creating these products and services for a global market. that's who I'm focusing my attention on. So I just want to come to you and say that and say yeah, that's it. I'm not doing this for money. I'm doing this because I can't do this. I cannot not do this and I know that I will get whatever is coming to me in abundance. So have a wonderful day.
